notes: coincasa.it (301) now permanently redirects to www.coin.it/it-it/ - Coincasa's standalone storefront has been merged into the unified Gruppo Coin e-commerce site ( reads 'Coin - Coincasa'); the former Coincasa home-decor catalog now lives under coin.it's 'casa' section. Extraction was performed on this merged site, scoped to home/casa seasonal categories only (clothing/beauty seasonal lines excluded as out of scope for Coincasa). Discovery via robots.txt -> sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_0-category.xml (3124 category URLs) for it-it slugs containing natal*/festa/regali/pasqua-primavera, cross-checked against the site's own en-it translated URL slugs, then each candidate PLP fetched directly (SFCC/Demandware storefront; qty read from the rendered '<span class="product-count">N Prodotti</span>' grid header). Confirmed absent after inspection: Halloween, Diwali/Indian festivals, Thanksgiving, New Year, St. Patrick's Day (no natal-adjacent or festival slugs found anywhere in the 3124-URL category sitemap or nav). Root 'natale-casa' (Christmas) has no own PLP - /it-it/natale-casa/ redirects to the homepage and is not itself listed in the sitemap, so it is recorded as a pure grouping row. Excluded as investigated-but-not-genuinely-seasonal: /it-it/natale-casa/camera-da-letto/ (9 products) and /it-it/natale-casa/bagno-1/ (6 products) - both nested under the Christmas URL branch but their listed products (plaid throws, checked-pattern pillowcases/duvet covers, plain bathrobes/towels) carry no Christmas branding or naming, i.e. generic room-organized gift-idea cross-sell rather than genuine Christmas product categories (Rule 5). Excluded /it-it/natale-casa/eve-party/* and /it-it/natale-casa/love-holiday/* (7 and 4 leaf URLs respectively, all named Christmas sub-types e.g. 'Luci natalizie', 'Addobbi Albero di Natale') because every one currently renders 'Nessun risultato, prova di nuovo' (0 products) - dropped per the 0-product convention rather than written as zero rows; likely stale/out-of-season named collection lines. Excluded as sale/clearance, not holiday categories: /it-it/saldi/natale-casa/* (Christmas sale duplicates of the categories below), /it-it/shop-casa/outlet/natale/ (Christmas outlet). Excluded /it-it/shop-casa/coin-days/ (20 products, generic loyalty/shopping-event page, no holiday association in title/H1/content) and /it-it/shop-casa/aria-di-bianco/ (298 products, title 'Fiera del Bianco 2026' - a traditional Italian household-linen sale event, i.e. a discount/clearance season, not a festival/holiday). Excluded non-seasonal /it-it/regali/* buckets: regali-anniversario, regali-laurea, regali-per-lei/per-lui/beauty/bambini/chi-ama-gli-animali/fitness, regali-per-fasce-di-prezzo (price bands), giftcard, regali-artigianali-e-unici, regali-eco-e-sostenibili - none tied to a specific holiday/occasion. 'La tavola di Primavera' is included as Easter (page <title> is literally 'Decorazioni e tovaglie per la tavola di Pasqua e Primavera' = Easter & Spring table decorations, ahead of its H1 'La tavola di Primavera'); flagged for review given the dual Easter/Spring naming. 'Festa d'Estate' (Summer Party) is included as Summer per the site's own dedicated 2026-dated collection page/H1/PLP, but flagged MANUAL REVIEW because its own sub-structure mirrors the entire generic room-based catalog (mobili, illuminazione-interni, tessili-casa, outdoor, tavola-e-cucina, bagno, camera-da-letto, soggiorno - 50+ leaf URLs) rather than a Christmas-style holiday-specific taxonomy; only the root PLP qty is recorded, its many generic room-based children were not individually extracted given this ambiguity and to avoid scope creep beyond a home-decor seasonal read. ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed 'Summer Party Collection' (festa-d'estate) row -- its own sub-navigation mirrors the entire generic room-based catalog (50+ leaf URLs across furniture/lighting/textiles/outdoor/tableware/bath/bedroom/living room), the 'generic catalog reused under a holiday-named URL' pattern, not a genuine occasion-specific category.
